layers.description: Runtime URL derivation, route constants, feature flags, server settings, and endpoint definitions.

layers.name: Auth Permissions
layers.description: Login, Keycloak token lifecycle, protected access checks, JWT role extraction, and permission mapping.

layers.name: API Clients
layers.description: Thin endpoint-specific API functions for tenants, agencies, counselors, admins, topics, users, settings, statistics, and invite links.

layers.name: Query Hooks Data
layers.description: React Query hooks that bind API clients to screens and own cache keys, stale times, mutations, and refetch behavior.

layers.name: Admin Pages
layers.description: Route-level pages for tenants, tenant settings, agencies, users, topics, profile, statistics, invite links, logs, and global settings.

layers.name: Shared UI Forms
layers.description: Reusable layout, card, form, table, modal, editor, upload, typography, and tenant-setting components.

layers.name: Domain Models
layers.description: Types, enums, constants, and small state helpers that define the admin domain vocabulary.

layers.name: Localization Assets Styles
layers.description: Translations, static templates, styles, public assets, and bundled image/font resources.

layers.name: Tests Quality
layers.description: Cypress specs, support files, and test configuration for the admin UI.

layers.description: Vite, TypeScript, package scripts, Docker, nginx, Kubernetes ingress, shell deployment scripts, and root tooling files.

tour.title: Project And Runtime Entry
tour.description: Start with the README, package manifest, and bootstrap entry to understand the app purpose, commands, providers, and protected app shell.

tour.title: Configuration And API Boundary
tour.description: Read endpoint and route definitions in appConfig, then inspect fetchData to understand auth, CSRF, timeout, and error handling across all API clients.

tour.title: Authentication And Authorization
tour.description: Follow login through token storage, protected route checks, token refresh, role parsing, and permission derivation.

tour.title: Tenant And Agency Administration
tour.description: Inspect tenant and agency screens, their hooks, and API clients to understand the central admin workflows.

tour.title: User, Topic, Invite, And Settings Workflows
tour.description: Review user management, topics, invite links, logs, and global settings modules for the remaining operational surfaces.

tour.title: Delivery And Operations
tour.description: Finish with build, container, nginx, ingress, and deployment scripts to see how the admin app is shipped into the ORISO environment.
